title: Binary-Input RS Encoder
text: Create Reed-Solomon code from binary vector data, 1 input, 1 output, {Primitive polynomial} sets Primitive polynomial ’X^3 + X +; {Codeword length N (symbols)}, {Message length K (symbols)} sets the message word length, {Shortened message length S (symbols)} sets the shortened message word length, {Generator polynomial}, {Puncture vector} and {Output data type} sets the output type of the block Same. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Generator polynomial
params.values: Generator polynomial rsgenpoly(7, 3, [], [], ’double’) (default) | polynomial character vector | binary row vector | binary Galois row vector

params.name: Primitive polynomial
params.values: Primitive polynomial ’X^3 + X + 1’ (default) | polynomial character vector | binary row vector

params.name: Puncture vector
params.values: Puncture vector [ones(2,1); zeros(2,1)] (default) | binary column vector

params.name: Output data type
params.values: Output type of the block Same as input (default) | boolean | double
